title: New in Symfony 8.2: Targeted Cache-Control and Cache-Status Headers
content:
<html><head></head><body>An HTTP response can pass through several caches before it reaches the user,
and you may want different rules for each one. Symfony 8.2 adds support for two
HTTP headers: one to set those rules, and another to see what happened to a
request.

Targeted Cache-Control…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
